name: Guardian cryptic crossword, Penguin book 7 No 60
preamble: Solve the clues and fit the solutions into the diagram jigsaw-wise, wherever they will go.

clue.text: Time within an inland charge — disease
Sticky plants will shortly sound like gull
Caesar's killer, not I, die by force
Non-cantorial from French waterway
Builds in Dyfed if I estimate
Gilbert's window-cleaner … now First Lord
Stress for queen in what secretes, where's crime
Coiled like snail, some licence comes in cure
Girl of peace or wrath when born in France?
Bill, in work, 's left snake in plant from heaven (5'1,6) and celebration: clip is watertight
Student's in to weep, old mate to wipe
See a barrel coloured green as tweed
Wrongly bill for fat outside one's church
Neophytes corrupting crewmen so
Round was going engine: Gothic castle
Country of the French (say?) gets the cash
and stops what extra railway engine does
No time's lost in source of particles?
I leave Irish heavyweight in Lancs
Spanish fighter marketed a note
Strain is back in piece of wood or saw
Ordered bonus order — get off chest
Holiday for monarch, being F
Battery is fit, and rest inside
Central line-up: horn is raised round team
Car they used, but I have gone by boat
Fermentation — last two isles of herb
